description: The Twitch Affiliate tracker is a Studio Pro tool (paid). This returns what it checks (followers, hours, days live and average viewers over 30 days against Twitch's bar of 25 followers, 4 hours, 4 days and 3 average viewers, and what's left), the price and how to subscribe. Twitch's own Creator Dashboard (Achievements) shows a channel's official Affiliate progress for free.
name: check_twitch_affiliate_progress
title: Twitch Affiliate progress
